name: Israel
overview: Scripture reveals Israel as the chosen seed of Abraham, promised to become a great and mighty nation whose descendants would be as numerous as the dust of the earth and the stars in the sky. God declared that through Israel all families of the earth would be blessed, highlighting their central role in His redemptive plan. Though foretold to endure affliction and servitude in a foreign land for four hundred years, God assured that He would judge their oppressors and bring Israel out with great substance, affirming His faithfulness to His covenant promises.
